historical_claims.anchor: Andreuccio of Perugia, a horse trader

historical_claims.anchor: In Messina, Lisabetta lives with three brothers

scope: Whole-work introduction through the complete frame and selected tales; not a retelling of all one hundred stories.

transcript.scope: Original overview narration and non-spoken reading companion.

setting.note: The introduction follows the Decameron frame set in Florence’s 1348 plague; this does not date composition of the whole collection or the embedded tales.

description: Examines storytelling within the plague frame, connecting selected or installment-specific tales to desire, wit, religion, household power, and social judgment. Whole-work introduction through the complete frame and selected tales; not a retelling of all one hundred stories. Covers Leaving Florence; A saint made of words; Three rings and a dangerous question; Returning with the stories.
